Callout.Name: Organised Crime - Meeting in Progress
Callout.Message: Meeting of two groups at a rural property.
Callout.Advisory: Six or more vehicles at the address.

Script.Line: We are having a barbecue. Six cars, two people and a barbecue.
Nothing is happening here tonight. Nothing has ever happened here.
If I go over that fence you are not going to like what happens next.

Stages.Stage: Two of them are at the gate, watching the road.
They have seen the unit. They are going over the back fence.

Lines.Approach: Six vehicles at a house that holds two people. Nobody meets in that car park by accident.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
